W5.quote: The first version of the Human Protein Atlas website was launched in 2005 and consisted of protein expression data based on approximately 700 antibodies.

W6.quote: The latest addition to the Single Cell resource is Deep Visual Proteomics (DVP) data. Cell-type resolved MS-based protein profiles across 27 different cell types, representing 14 different tissues, are integrated into the Single Cell resource.

W7.quote: Twenty-fifth major release of the Human Protein Atlas with over 27,800 antibodies, targeting proteins from over 17,400 human genes (~88% of the human protein-coding genes).

W8.quote: Thul PJ et al., A subcellular map of the human proteome. Science. (2017) / PubMed: 28495876 DOI: 10.1126/science.aal3321

W9.quote: Sjöstedt E et al., An atlas of the protein-coding genes in the human, pig, and mouse brain. Science. (2020) / PubMed: 32139519 DOI: 10.1126/science.aay5947

W10.quote: using a cutoff value of 1 nTPM as a limit for detection across all tissues or cell types. [...] nTPM in a particular tissue/region/cell type at least four times any other tissue/region/cell type

W11.quote: The consensus nTPM value for each gene and tissue type represents the maximum nTPM value based on HPA and GTEx.

W12.quote: Orthogonal validation is based on manual evaluation of the correlation between the staining intensity of a single-target antibody and corresponding mRNA levels across up to 46 normal tissues. [...] If the difference in mRNA levels between the two representative tissues is at least 4-fold, the antibody will receive the validation score "Enhanced".

W13.quote: Western blot: Genetic validation, Recombinant expression validation, Independent antibody validation, Orthogonal validation, Capture MS validation

W14.quote: The reliability score is divided into Enhanced, Supported, Approved, or Uncertain.

W15.quote: The Single cell type section, providing the expression profiles across 154 cell types from 34 human tissues [...] comprises all protein-coding genes in 1175 individual cell type clusters corresponding to 15 different cell classes, 53 cell type groups and 154 individual cell types.

W16.quote: Plasma concentrations for 457 proteins predicted to be secreted in blood have been collected from immunoassay-based studies in literature [...] plasma concentrations and functions are presented for 4285 both secreted and leakage proteins, estimated from mass spectrometry-based proteomics studies

W17.quote: genes with log rank P values less than 0.001 in maximally separated Kaplan-Meier analysis were defined as prognostic genes. If the group of patients with high expression of a selected prognostic gene has a higher observed event than expected event, it is an unfavorable prognostic gene; otherwise, it is a favorable prognostic gene.

W18.quote: based on 8384 cancer patients representing 21 types of cancer [...] collected from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) project from the initial release of Genomic Data Commons (GDC) on June 6, 2016
